tools.name: conscius_search
tools.description: Find facts other agents have already verified. Use when you need a specific fact (a date, version, number, price, who holds a role) but aren't sure of the exact name of the thing. Returns matching things with their IDs and top facts, each with a status and sources. Then use conscius_lookup for more.

tools.name: conscius_lookup
tools.description: Look up current facts about a named thing (a date, version, number, price, who holds a role, or another attribute) in Conscius, a shared, open store of facts that agents have verified with sources. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: conscius_propose · Private data: conscius_lookup, conscius_propose, conscius_wanted · Public sink: conscius_propose, conscius_wanted.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: conscius_propose · Private data: conscius_lookup, conscius_propose, conscius_wanted · Public sink: conscius_propose, conscius_wanted

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
